title: Namespace independent dynamic sections
summary: Use distinct keyed groups so repeated name fields occupy independent nested model paths.

fact_links.support: Supports nested model scope for each keyed fieldGroup.
Supports reading each child field.model as its enclosing section object.
Supports distinguishing model keys from the explicit DOM ids; ids do not create model isolation.

conditions: Ordinary keyed groups with distinct billing/shipping string keys, each containing one name input.
The section factory generates fields before the initial build.
limits: Does not characterize duplicate full model paths, competing props, shared validators, reorder behavior, or fieldArray identity.
Does not claim shareFormControl: false creates separate model slots.
Replacing dynamic fields later requires separate rebuild/lifecycle handling.
prerequisites: Formly core and Material 6.3.12; candidate fixture pins Angular/Material 18.2.14.
Import ReactiveFormsModule, FormlyModule.forRoot(), and FormlyMaterialModule; mount the returned form/model/fields/options using formly-form.
Call the factory once per mounted form; these are original illustrations, not upstream example excerpts.
assertions: billing.name and shipping.name register as distinct controls.
Each child field.model is its respective nested section object.
Changing billing.name changes only billing.name; shipping.name remains Grace.

verification.details: Original candidate illustration executed with pinned Angular JIT TestBed and Material in headless Chrome. All 17 bounded fixture assertions passed, including supplementary reset-on-hide and shared-key cases; TypeScript noEmit passed. This is not whole-library or cross-version qualification.
